steps.title: Domains and TLS
steps.subtitle: Set your public hostname, and list the same name in Homepage's HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS. Turn Let's Encrypt off for a name that is not public.

steps.title: Reverse proxy
steps.subtitle: Point BunkerWeb at Homepage's port 3000. Keep the address without a path.

steps.title: HTTP - Request rate and parallel requests
steps.subtitle: Homepage asks for every tile at once when it opens. These values fit 5 browsers opening 60 tiles together, raise them for more tiles.

steps.title: HTTP - Error messages
steps.subtitle: Show the real error text in widget tiles instead of BunkerWeb's error page.

steps.title: Security - Sign-in attempts
steps.subtitle: LIMIT_REQ_URL_1 and LIMIT_REQ_RATE_1 allow 10 password tries a minute when you turn on Homepage's own sign-in.

steps.title: Security - Bad behavior status codes
steps.subtitle: A failing widget or status dot answers 400, 401, 403 or 404 on every refresh. Keep those codes out of the ban counter.

steps.title: Security - Sign-in with authentik (optional)
steps.subtitle: Leave empty to skip. To require an authentik sign-in, fill REVERSE_PROXY_HOST_1 (the outpost address), REVERSE_PROXY_AUTH_REQUEST and REVERSE_PROXY_AUTH_REQUEST_SIGNIN_URL as the README shows.

steps.title: Security - Review CRS exclusions
steps.subtitle: Skip injection rules for search text and service names.
